name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

fixed: Each dungeon floor you clear now saves as its own run with its own link, instead of separate floors getting combined into one.
Clearing a floor is now correctly recorded as a clear.
changed: New installs now save your run automatically when the results screen appears, so a cleared floor is captured out of the box. Your existing settings are kept.
